title: The World of The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping x Scentbird NYCC Giveaway
summary: Step into the world of The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping with Scentbird at New York Comic Con. To celebrate the story’s return to the spotlight, Scentbird has created a limited-edition fragr…
body_markdown:
Step into the world of *The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping* with Scentbird at New York Comic Con. To celebrate the story’s return to the spotlight, Scentbird has created a limited-edition fragrance collection inspired by the world of Panem. And now, you can take it home with you: four fans will have the chance to win the complete collection, featuring the Eau de Parfum in four sizes plus a limited-edition fragrance case. Share your Hunger Games experience at NYCC for your chance to win, and read the official rules below for full details.


### Giveaway Period


October 9–11, 2026


### How to Enter


To enter, share your Hunger Games experience at New York Comic Con in a post or Story on Instagram or TikTok during the giveaway period and include @scentbird and #TheHungerGames.


### Eligibility


Entrants must be 18 years of age or older and legal residents of the United States. Your social media profile must be public at the time of entry and winner selection so that Scentbird can view and verify your entry. Entries from private accounts cannot be verified and are not eligible to win.


No purchase necessary. Void where prohibited.


### Winner Selection


Winners will be randomly selected from all eligible entries received and verified in accordance with these rules. Four (4) Winners will be randomly selected daily during the giveaway period.


Winners will receive The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping x Scentbird collection.


- One (1) The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping x Scentbird Eau De Parfum – 50ml
- One (1) The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping x Scentbird Eau De Parfum – 20ml
- One (1) The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping x Scentbird Eau De Parfum – 9ml
- One (1) The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping x Scentbird Eau De Parfum – 8ml
- One (1) The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping x Scentbird Eau De Parfum – Limited-edition Fragrance Case


Scentbird will never ask you to send money, make a purchase, provide payment information, or pay a fee in order to claim a prize. Do not respond to messages from any other account claiming to represent Scentbird in connection with this giveaway.


Potential winners may be required to confirm eligibility and provide information reasonably necessary to fulfill the prize. Potential winners must respond within 24 hours of initial notification. Failure to respond within 24 hours will result in forfeiture of the prize, and an alternate winner may be selected. Potential winners may also forfeit the prize if they cannot be verified or are otherwise ineligible.


### Additional Terms


Entries must include @driftgoods and #TheHungerGames and comply with Instagram’s or TikTok’s applicable terms and community guidelines. Entries that are incomplete, cannot be viewed or verified, or otherwise do not comply with these giveaway requirements may be disqualified.


By participating in this promotion and submitting an entry, all entrants agree to (i) be bound by these terms, including all entry requirements, and (ii) waive any and all claims against Drift (“Sponsor”), Lions Gate Entertainment Inc., and each of their respective parents, affiliated companies, subsidiaries, licensees, distributors, dealers, retailers, printers and advertising and promotion agencies (collectively, “Released Parties”) for any injury, damage or loss of any kind (including, but not limited to, personal injury, death, or damage to or loss of property) that may occur, directly or indirectly, in whole or in part, from the participation in the promotion, or any promotion-related activity or from the acceptance, receipt, possession and/or use or misuse of any prize.


This promotion is not sponsored, endorsed, administered by, or associated with Lions Gate Entertainment Inc., Instagram or TikTok.
